subject: Meditech MAP: acceptance-window shift & mitigation ledger
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@meditech.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: jana.korz@meditech.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rebaseline request — acceptance window slipping

Vanessa / Jonas,

Quick update from our side — the compliance validation team ran the quarterly audit on the integration sandbox and uncovered a logging/retention gap that blocks our acceptance testing for two major flows. That means the acceptance window we agreed (target go-live 2026-09-01) can't be met unless we change scope or extend.

This is the first time this issue has come up in our testing, but remediation will take 10–14 business days and requires a redeploy and a small schema change on our side. Our legal team also flagged a minor data retention addendum that needs review.

Planned ask: request we push the soft go-live by 3 weeks and update the MAP to reflect a phased acceptance (core API first, non-critical analytics later). I attached a brief from the compliance team and a proposed rebaseline in XLS.

Attachments: Compliance_Findings_081226.pdf (report), MAP_v2.xlsx (proposed rebaseline)

Can we confirm whether Redwood can support a limited-feature cutover and whether we can keep the committed throughput SLA for the core APIs? We want to avoid changing commercial terms if possible.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Director, Integrations — Meditech Health

---

(On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 08:50 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com wrote:)
> Wereceived the compliance note earlier — thanks for flagging, Tom.

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@meditech.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rebaseline request — acceptance window slipping

Tom,

Appreciate the heads up and the attachments — read through the compliance brief. Two quick thoughts:

- Limited-feature cutover sounds reasonable (core API first). We can lock the core-facing SLA during the phased release if the non-core features are scoped to a delayed tranche.
- To avoid commercial churn, wewill propose a MAP amendment (no pricing change) that documents a phased acceptance and a brief credit cap if acceptance extends beyond the new window.

Next steps I propose this afternoon:
1) Internal triage (Jonas, Mina) to confirm feasibility of phased deployment and whether any infra work is required on our side.
2) Joint MAP update draft (Ican run the doc) and a short legal touchpoint to review the retention addendum.
3) Sit down tomorrow for 30m to finalize dates.

Can you confirm whether Meditech can run the compliance validation again by Aug 26 if we push to a 3-week shift? If not, weshould map a 4-week contingency.

Attachments referenced: MAP_v2.xlsx (you uploaded), Compliance_Findings_081226.pdf

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference — Sales

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, tom.reynolds@meditech.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rebaseline request — acceptance window slipping

Vanessa / Tom — quick internal note, copying back to Meditech.

I pulled the proposed MAP_v2 and ran a short engineering impact assessment:
- Phased cutover (core API then analytics) is low-risk for our runtime — we can isolate the analytics ingestion path into a gated rollout.
- Work required: 1) small migration of the ingestion queue (2 dev days, 1 infra day), 2) an updated E2E test run (2 days) to validate KV cache persistence across the cutover.

Risk log excerpt (brief):
1) Compliance remediation on customer schema — medium risk, 10–14 business days
2) Test re-run failure — medium-low risk, 48–72 hours additional
3) Third-party analytics connector latency — low risk, can be deferred to tranche 2

I recommend we escalate internally for the following exceptions to maintain momentum:
- Temporary acceptance-window extension to 2026-09-22 (3 weeks) with a hard contingency checkpoint on 2026-09-29.
- Approval to run a limited-feature production pilot for core APIs (ops-controlled feature flag).

If Sales/Leadership OK these asks, I will book the engineering slots and start the test cycles.

Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas / Vanessa.

We reviewed the internal remediation plan and confirmed the team can complete the fixes and run the compliance validation by Aug 28 if Redwood can commit to the phased acceptance approach and the pilot flag for core APIs. Jana (legal) is copied for the retention addendum; she'll push a short addendum for signature if we agree the dates.

From Meditech perspective:
- Weaccept the proposed extension to 2026-09-22 with the contingency on 2026-09-29.
- We'll sign a short MAP amendment that documents the phased acceptance and the contingency checkpoints.

Please send a draft amendment and the updated risk register so our legal and procurement teams can review.

Tom

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@meditech.com>, Jana Korz <jana.korz@meditech.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final MAP update and escalation summary — Meditech (action items)

Team — summary and next steps after today's alignment call with Meditech.

Decisions agreed:
- Go-live rebaseline: soft go-live moved to 2026-09-22. Contingency checkpoint: 2026-09-29.
- Scope: phased acceptance. Tranche 1 = core API surface (billing, auth, core read/write). Tranche 2 = analytics ingestion and non-critical telemetry.
- Commercials: no pricing change. Legal will circulate a one-page retention addendum (Jana). A small credit bucket (cap $20K) was agreed as a safety valve if final acceptance slips beyond the contingency date.

Action owners and deadlines:
- Jonas Weber: schedule engineering slots and run E2E validation (ETA 2026-08-24). Attachment: Risk_Register_Meditech_v1.pdf
- Mina Haddad: draft MAP amendment and one-page retention addendum for legal (ETA 2026-08-21). Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx
- Vanessa Ortiz: coordinate procurement check-ins and confirm SLA gating for core APIs (ETA 2026-08-20).

Meeting cadence: twice-weekly standups (Mon / Thu) until tranche 1 is accepted.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (updated MAP draft), Risk_Register_Meditech_v1.pdf (risk log), Compliance_Findings_081226.pdf (original findings)

If anyone needs this escalated to Sales leadership for credit approval earlier, flag by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — I'll track these in the deal thread (DEAL-3421).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
